data.gender_notes: Finbur is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Celtic name Finna, which means 'fair' or 'handsome'. This name was popular among the ancient Celts and was believed to bring good fortune. The name Finbur carries the meaning “Fair, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Finbur usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
